summary: Frontend-only validation of Notifications module optimization in Project detail (prj_e86a47af1bff). All 3 modals are ~78% viewport wide, and all 3 send buttons now go through an AlertDialog confirmation. Cancel keeps parent modal open; Confirm dispatches the actual send request. 7/7 test cases PASSED.

issues: Pre-existing console warnings: <span> inside <tr>/<tbody>/<th>/<td> hydration warnings and DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby. Non-blocking, already reported in iter228.

Embedded template images point to a different preview host (https://quote-overhaul.preview.emergentagent.com/api/projects/images/*.png) instead of REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. In the current preview host they resolve but generate ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME log noise; consider using a relative /api/projects/images path or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL prefix to be environment-agnostic. Non-blocking for send confirmation feature.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx correctly gates all 3 send actions via requestSendConfirmation(fn) → executePendingSend pattern using a single pendingSendRef; wiring for send-next-notif (line 2414), send-adhoc-email-btn (2711) and the EmailPreviewDialog prop sendFromPreview (2737) all route through the same AlertDialog (confirm-send-dialog at 2747).

The AlertDialog uses semantic controls (AlertDialogCancel/AlertDialogAction) and has the required data-testids: confirm-send-dialog / confirm-send-cancel / confirm-send-accept. Cancel does NOT reset the parent modal (verified: notif/adhoc/preview modals remain open after Cancel).

Modal widths use Tailwind arbitrary values w-[78vw] max-w-[78vw] on DialogContent — measured 1497.6px on a 1920px viewport ⇒ 78.0% for all three modals (notifications-btn, adhoc-email-dialog, email-preview-dialog).

Send endpoint from Preview reuses POST /api/projects/{id}/send-notification (same as send-next-notif); adhoc uses POST /api/projects/{id}/send-adhoc-email. Both confirmed dispatched only after clicking Confirm.

ProjectDetail.jsx already exceeds the 700-line guideline (>2750 lines). Consider extracting the notifications block (dialogs + confirm) into a dedicated component for maintainability. Not required for this iteration.
